Ledger Recover review: digital legacy verdict

Verdict: An optional, ID-based seed backup for Ledger hardware wallets. Handy for recovery, but it's a trust trade-off and isn't primarily an inheritance tool. Best for: Ledger owners worried about losing their seed phrase who accept ID verification.

Key facts

  • Category: Crypto inheritance
  • Pricing: Paid subscription (Ledger has advertised $9.99/month). Check current pricing.
  • Best for: Ledger owners worried about losing their seed phrase who accept ID verification.
  • Encrypted seed split across three companies
  • Recover with ID on a new Ledger device

Official site / docs ↗

What are the pros and cons of Ledger Recover?

Pros

  • Encrypted seed split across three companies
  • Recover with ID on a new Ledger device
  • A trusted-contact option is sold on Ledger's store

Cons

  • Requires government ID verification
  • Controversial with self-custody purists
  • Availability depends on the country your ID was issued in

Frequently asked questions

Is Ledger Recover good for digital legacy planning?

An optional, ID-based seed backup for Ledger hardware wallets. Handy for recovery, but it's a trust trade-off and isn't primarily an inheritance tool.

Who is Ledger Recover best for?

Ledger owners worried about losing their seed phrase who accept ID verification.

How much does Ledger Recover cost?

Paid subscription (Ledger has advertised $9.99/month). Check current pricing.

What are the downsides of Ledger Recover?

Requires government ID verification; Controversial with self-custody purists; Availability depends on the country your ID was issued in.

What are alternatives to Ledger Recover?

Alternatives in the same category include Casa, Unchained, Vault12 Guard.

What are similar tools?

Crypto inheritance

Casa

Crypto inheritance

Unchained

Collaborative-custody Bitcoin vaults (2-of-3 multisig) with inheritance planning. Strong for larger holdings.

Crypto inheritance

Vault12 Guard

Backs up seed phrases using trusted 'Guardians' and lets you name a beneficiary who can inherit after a 48-hour owner veto window and Guardian approvals.
